channel.title: Bergman Island
channel.desc: Romance 2021 Searching for inspiration, two filmmaking couples head to the island that helped Ingmar Bergman to write such profoundly personal meditation screenplays, but eventually, they lose themselves to the pulse of its living nature. Vicky Krieps, Tim Roth, Mia Wasikowska, Anders Danielsen Lie, Hampus Nordenson, Mia Hansen-Love, Mia Hansen-Love.
